title: Configuration input index
statement: For a Boolean-input finite Turing machine $M$, natural numbers $N,T,t,p$, define the input index to be $t$ times the configuration stride, plus $k(2T+1)+p$, where the configuration stride is $k(2T+1)+N+3$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ with Boolean input
